title: JANUS Engine R0B — Water condensate recovery and reoxygenation balance
goal: Quantify how much water accompanies the extracted oxygen stream, how much can be recovered by demisting and condensation, and what fraction of the recovered water can be returned to the water loop after reoxygenation.
critical_distinction: Extracting dissolved O2 does not consume bulk water. It lowers dissolved-oxygen concentration. Condensed water recovered from the oxygen stream replaces water carried over as vapor or droplets, but it does not by itself restore dissolved oxygen; reoxygenation requires transfer of O2 back into the returned water or replenishment from an oxygenated external source.
oxygen_stream_water_sources: water vapor crossing or evaporating at the membrane interface
entrained microdroplets or aerosol from the rotating gill surface
liquid leakage through defects or wetting of the membrane
humidity generated by downstream warm sections

recovery_train.stage_2: condenser cools the humid oxygen stream below its dew point and recovers condensed water
recovery_train.stage_3: condensate collector measures recovered liquid mass
recovery_train.stage_4: recovered water is returned only after compatibility, cleanliness and dissolved-gas state are characterized
recovery_train.stage_5: reoxygenation module restores the target dissolved-O2 concentration if a closed or semi-closed water loop is used

humidity_model.note: If the oxygen-side membrane remains effectively dry and rejects liquid water, recoverable water may be very small. This must be measured rather than assumed.

reoxygenation_balance.target: Return water to the gill loop at a specified dissolved-O2 setpoint rather than merely returning recovered liquid volume.
possible_sources: controlled sidestream from the collected oxygen product if energetically justified
gas-liquid contactor supplied from another oxygen source
reoxygenation_balance.closure_rule: A closed-water-loop claim requires simultaneous closure of water mass balance and dissolved-O2 mass balance.

required_measurements: oxygen_stream dew point or humidity before separator/condenser
oxygen_stream dew point or humidity after condenser
conductivity_or_salinity of recovered condensate where relevant
contamination indicators from membrane or lubricant carryover

success_metrics.water_balance: Measured condensate plus remaining stream humidity explains water carried from the gill within uncertainty.
success_metrics.oxygen_balance: O2 removed at the gill, O2 collected, and O2 used for any reoxygenation sidestream close independently within uncertainty.
success_metrics.system_metric: Report grams of water recovered per gram of O2 collected and joules spent per gram of water recovered/reoxygenated.

next_gate: R0B1_HUMIDITY_BASELINE: with the rotating-gill geometry frozen, measure oxygen-stream humidity and droplet carryover before adding a condenser; then size the separator/condenser from measured water loading rather than assuming condensate yield.
